review.notes: Full review. Every cited section of 13 supplier and consumer roadmaps resolved on main or at the open heads. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with no message and declares nothing; the four library names in its docstring exist at the pins. The worker's automatic checks all passed.
